title: 82626B0065-BEDC - CSO-GC-SFS-OH-CP3 Construction of CSO Facilities for Gowanus Canal
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text:
Construction of the CSO facility superstructure, reconstruction/abandonment of impacted conveyance, and construction of public amenities above the below ground portions of the tank. The scope of OH-CP3 also includes installation of all CSO Facility components and conveyance including mechanical equipment, new force mains, electrical conduits and equipment, heating, ventilation, air conditioning components, architectural features, plumbing, and a Con Ed network protection structure, property line manhole, and duct bank installation. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82626B0065 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact MOCS Service Desk: mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8
